rules.description: Entity must be an employer who deducts tax and National Insurance from wages
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be an employer registered for PAYE to have workplace pension duties

rules.description: Employer must have at least one member of staff
rules.reason_if_failed: Workplace pension duties begin when your first member of staff starts working for you

rules.description: At least one worker must meet auto-enrollment criteria
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have at least one worker aged 22 to State Pension age earning £10,000+/year who normally works in the UK

rules.description: Scheme must be set up before the first payday after duties start date
rules.reason_if_failed: You must set up the scheme before your first payday. Contact TPR immediately if you have missed this deadline.

edge_cases.description: Employer already has a workplace pension scheme
edge_cases.action: Verify the existing scheme meets auto-enrollment rules. If not, you must set up a qualifying scheme.

edge_cases.description: Employer has already passed first payday without setting up scheme
edge_cases.action: Immediate handoff to TPR. Employer may face penalties. Must backdate enrollment and contributions.

edge_cases.description: Workers who are based in UK but travel abroad for work
edge_cases.action: Workers who normally work in the UK are eligible even if they travel abroad. Verify 'normally works in UK' criteria with TPR guidance.

edge_cases.description: Workers whose earnings fluctuate around the £10,000 threshold
edge_cases.action: Monitor earnings each pay period. Enroll workers within 6 weeks when they first meet the £10,000/year threshold.
